title: Define the shared surveillance capabilities that qualify as DPI-H
requirements:
- Apply the component-selection criteria to the PHSP and define its scope as modular capabilities with progressive implementation
- Bound the component as a modular shared capability, naming what stays in other systems
- State which functions each example tool illustrates and how it differs from a full shared surveillance capability
- Define surveillance, monitoring, intelligence and response terms
- Define progressive maturity from priority notifications to advanced analytics
- Add scope, maturity and maintenance status for each example
- Clarify boundaries with laboratory systems and contact-tracing workflows
- Make clear it covers all public-health events (e.g. VPD, AEFI, MPDSR), not only epidemics and climate events
